title: Aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="38" ry="12" fill="#7ec8f0"/>
  <!-- Fuselage highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="34" ry="6" fill="#a8dcf7"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="55" r="11" fill="#f0a0c0"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="55" r="7" fill="#f7c0d8"/>
  <!-- Cockpit windows -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="50" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#70b0f0"/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d="M15 55 L8 30 L25 40 Z" fill="#f0a0c0"/>
  <path d="M15 52 L12 35 L22 42 Z" fill="#f7c0d8"/>
  <!-- Tail stabilizer -->
  <path d="M18 55 L10 62 L24 58 Z" fill="#f0a0c0"/>
  <!-- Main wing (top) -->
  <path d="M45 46 L35 25 L60 38 Z" fill="#f7d040"/>
  <path d="M45 44 L38 29 L55 38 Z" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <!-- Main wing (bottom) -->
  <path d="M45 64 L35 82 L60 70 Z" fill="#f7d040"/>
  <path d="M45 62 L38 78 L55 68 Z" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <!-- Engine top -->
  <rect x="48" y="40" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="#9090b0"/>
  <rect x="50" y="41" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#c0c0e0"/>
  <!-- Engine bottom -->
  <rect x="48" y="62" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="#9090b0"/>
  <rect x="50" y="63" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#c0c0e0"/>
  <!-- Propeller -->
  <ellipse cx="95" cy="55" rx="3" ry="14" fill="#c0d8f0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="95" cy="55" r="3" fill="#f0f0ff"/>
  <!-- Windows along body -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <circle cx="37" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <!-- Smile on nose -->
  <path d="M82 59 Q85 62 88 59" stroke="#d06090" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eyes on nose -->
  <circle cx="81" cy="53" r="1.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="53" r="1.5" fill="#3050a0"/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="58" r="2" fill="#f7c0d8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="58" r="2" fill="#f7c0d8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
